# Complex Physics Equations

## Mechanics
F = dp/dt

p = m · v

E = ½mv²

τ = r × F

L = r × p

ω = √(k/m)

## Electromagnetism
E = −∇φ − ∂A/∂t

B = ∇ × A

∇ · E = ρ/ε₀

∇ × B = μ₀J + μ₀ε₀ ∂E/∂t

## Thermodynamics
dS ≥ 0

S = k_B ln(W) where k_B is Boltzmann's constant.

ΔG = ΔH − TΔS
